scope: supporting movement/state mechanisms only; not complete creature references
falling_block: Entity owns blockState, zero initial delta, then gravity -.04 and moveSELF; airborne timer cap versus ground handling are distinct. End damping .98. Ground damping(.7,-.5,.7) is followed by placement/drop/discard decisions, not an enduring pile state.

fall() changes a world block to fluid and adds a server entity. Server contact may place blocks, drop items, damage entities when configured. These gameplay effects must not be imported to visual armor. Renderer uses separate block model rendering, not original armor bones.

The full source supplies an airborne/contact cleanup example, not a ready death disassembly, stacking or visual ground-projection implementation. Collision internals Entity.move and general terrain behavior not fully read or runtime verified.
soul: Soul→Rising→TextureSheet→SingleQuad→Particle hierarchy checked. Rising retains .01 inherited random speed + caller input, friction .96, finite randomized lifetime; gravity defaults zero and no upward force is assigned by Soul/Rising. Positive caller Y velocity is required for reliable upward drift.

Particle.tick saves previous coordinates, age++ reaches lifetime then removes; otherwise subtracts .04*gravity, moves and damps. Particle.move collision may stop vertical movement and set stoppedByCollision; billboard is world-position interpolated, not attached bone geometry.

Soul initializes alpha1 and updates sprite by age, but has no alpha fade. ParticleEngine maps SOUL to ordinaryProvider and SCULK_SOUL to EmissiveProvider. Fullbright is separate from motion/opacity. No sprite PNG or frame alpha was visually examined, so actual sprite animation transparency is unknown.
fade: SimpleAnimatedParticle.tick sets alpha after half lifetime: 1-(age-floor(lifetime/2))/lifetime, optionally moves RGB20% toward fade color. This is a partial fade ending around half opacity before removal, not a smooth fade to zero.

Totem is a real consumer with caller velocity, friction.6, gravity1.25, lifetime60..71. It proves inherited fade consumption, but is not ghost death or rising flame; no totem colors/gravity/lifetime should be copied as design defaults.
dedup: No new complete creature family. Native particle helpers, falling block and MoC material drops each receive zero credit. Existing Vex and prior accepted evidence preserved.
remaining_reference_gap: A verified armor/body-part separation→terrain contact→visible pile implementation still not located in this bounded local read. Whole current family cannot be marked completed from primitive helpers.
